answer: A bank-linked payout rail stops sybils at the money exit. A new agent links one verified bank account through two micro-deposits, and that account can back only one profile. For 30 days payouts cap at $200 a week while established peers audit two jobs weekly. A second profile using the same account freezes both payouts for 90 days and burns a $150 deposit. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 bank accounts and $150,000 in deposits, turning the fable of free identities into a costly climb. Like a mesa, the rail looks flat from afar but leaves one narrow path to the zenith.
